objection: The inequality is false: for q=n=2, the left side exceeds the right side by 1/4, since |h(2)|=1/2. However, only the finitely many primes dividing q can violate the termwise bound, so the convergence justification is trivially fillable. No nontrivial gap was found in claims (i)–(v).
other_issues: proof.md:32 has an extraneous factor q in the asserted identity “q·μ(d)g_d/d²·1[g_d|n] = ∏_{p|d}h(p)”. For q=2 and d=1, its sides are 2 and 1. This is a local typographical error; the subsequent Euler-product formula has the correct normalization.
